findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (51.47 yds from volume vs 48.65 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 0.39 per player (projected 30.5, actual 30.89).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.05 (projected 7.19, actual 7.14).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 65.77, without it 63.78. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 24/65 (36.92%). Our MAE 65.77 vs the line's 59.22. The book is the better projection.
